# KAIRO experiment report (generated by scripts/make_report.py)

## Configuration

* Scenarios: normal, high_volatility, low_liquidity, stress, regime_transition, liquidity_shock
* Seeds (5): [42, 123, 777, 2024, 31415]
* Training steps per learned model: 150,000
* Series length: 3000 bars; horizon 30 bars; order = 5.5% of the window's expected volume (BUY)
* Test windows per (scenario, seed): 30; total paired windows: 900

Δ IS = treatment − control in implementation-shortfall bps (negative = treatment cheaper). 'Seeds better' counts seeds whose mean paired difference is negative.
